Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding school attendance of children whose parents or guardians receive state assistance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school attendance of children whose parents orguardians receive state assistance; adding a new section to chapter43.20A RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of social and health services shall review the rulesof all programs that provide state assistance and require allrecipients of state assistance who are parents or legal guardians of aschoolaged child or whose schoolaged child receives state assistanceto ensure regular school attendance by their children as a conditionfor receiving any state assistance, if adding such criteria does notjeopardize the receipt of any federal funding. For the purposes ofthis section, it is sufficient for a parent of a student receivinghome-based instruction to show that the annual declaration of intentfor the student to receive home-based instruction has been filed forthe relevant year in accordance with RCW 28A.200.010.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
